messages:
kate: heads-up — pre-merge SAST flagged a HIGH on PR #4421. CI shows `sql-injection` pattern in user-facing handler. blocking policy is 'must have owner + evidence' before merge :no_entry:
sec-bot: automated-scan: SAST report attached: https://ci.internal/redwood/sast/4421 artifact: gs://redwood-scan-artifacts/4421.zip :rotating_light:
jamal: linking the PR now — do we have an owner assigned? looks like backend touched by @oliver and @alex in last commit
maria: question: who can upload the artifact to the secure bucket? artifact retention and kms key ACLs are strict — only team-scans@redwood and infra-kms-admin can write currently
oliver: i can own the finding. need a short repro and the exact file with stacktrace. can someone paste the snippet from the report? :eyes:
sre-ops: quick note: if upload needs a new principal, we need an RBAC change ticket and audit log entries; estimated lead time 1 business day unless we use temporary presigned url
alex: snippet from report: ```app/handlers/user.py:line 212
query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '{email}'"
db.execute(query)
```
kate: thanks alex — this looks like an obvious interpolation bug. oliver can you produce a small unit test that hits that branch and push to the PR? once we have the test + fix we can mark evidence and clear the block
maria: regarding KMS: to sign artifacts we require the key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/scan-keys/cryptoKeys/signer` to be usable by the CI service account. current policy: `roles/cloudkms.signer` granted to `ci-builder@redwood` and `team-scans@redwood` only. if we need to grant to someone else (e.g., triage bot) open infra-ticket and include justification for audit trail
jamal: if we can't wait for infra ticket, can we mfa-protect a presigned upload signed by infra for 24h? less ideal but helps unblock hotfixes
sre-ops: we can create a one-off presigned upload for the artifact bucket, but we will record the operation in audit logs and create a short-lived principal for visibility. prefer infra ticket for recurring needs
oliver: pushed a minimal failing unit test and a tentative fix in the PR. i also uploaded a redacted artifact to the secure bucket via presigned URL (logged by infra). link: gs://redwood-scan-artifacts/4421-redacted.zip
kate: perfect — cassie in security-ops, can you validate the artifact and mark the evidence? then i will waive the pre-merge block if fix lands and CI passes :slightly_smiling_face:
sec-bot: security-ops validated: evidence attached, SAST rule suppressed with justification 'repro + fix committed' by kate. suppression id: S-2026-4421
alex: follow-up — we should add a check to pre-merge linter to detect f-string or concat-based sql patterns. low-effort rule could catch most of these coder patterns
maria: agreed, also adding an entry to the KMS runbook: how to request temporary upload access and what logs to attach (ticket, who approved, artifact SHA)
sre-ops: logging note: make sure artifact upload operations emit `storage.upload` audit entries to the central audit index. retention for now is 400 days per compliance ask
kate: thanks all. assigning ownership to oliver for the ticket/PR and maria for KMS/runbook follow-up. closing thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
